title: Transport-Coupled Bayesian Flows for Molecular Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2510.10211v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular graph generation (MGG) is essentially a multi-class generative task, aimed at predicting categories of atoms and bonds under strict chemical and structural constraints. However, many prevailing diffusion paradigms learn to regress numerical embeddings and rely on a hard discretization rule during sampling to recover discrete labels. This introduces a fundamental discrepancy between training and sampling. While models are trained for point-wise numerical fidelity, the sampling process fundamentally relies on crossing categorical decision boundaries. This discrepancy forces the model to expend efforts on intra-class variations that become irrelevant after discretization, ultimately compromising diversity, structural statistics, and generalization performance. translated_title: 用于分子图生成的传输耦合贝叶斯流
translated_abstract: 分子图生成（MGG）本质上是一个多类别生成任务，旨在严格的化学和结构约束下预测原子和键的类别。然而，许多主流的扩散范式学习回归数值嵌入，并在采样过程中依赖硬离散化规则来恢复离散标签。这在训练和采样之间引入了根本性的差异：模型训练时追求的是逐点的数值保真度，而采样过程从根本上依赖于跨越类别决策边界。这种差异迫使模型在类内变化上花费精力，而这些变化在离散化后变得无关紧要，最终损害了多样性、结构统计特性和泛化性能。因此，我们提出了TopBF，一个统一框架，它（i）直接在连续参数分布中执行分子图生成，（ii）通过图拓扑理解进行学习……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出TopBF统一框架，通过传输耦合贝叶斯流直接在连续参数分布中进行分子图生成，解决了扩散模型训练与采样之间因硬离散化导致的根本性差异问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes TopBF, a unified framework that performs molecular graph generation directly in continuous parameter distributions via transport-coupled Bayesian flows, resolving the fundamental train-sample discrepancy caused by hard discretization in prevailing diffusion paradigms.
